questions.question: What new thing does Psalm 96 call for?
options: Bow before the LORD in fear
Wait upon the LORD in silence
Cry out to the LORD in distress
Sing to the LORD a new song
questions.answer: Sing to the LORD a new song

questions.question: How is the LORD contrasted with other gods?
options: All the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens
He stands first and foremost in rank high above all of the other gods
He is the greatest among the many gods worshiped by the nations
He is but one god among many others, yet he is unknown to most
questions.answer: All the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens

questions.question: The psalm says the LORD comes to judge the earth in righteousness.
Sing to the LORD a new _____; sing to the LORD, all the earth!
Ascribe to the LORD the glory due his name; bring an offering, and come into his _____!
